The tau PET data suggests that even in this early population, tau pathology was already established and not reversed by amyloid clearance, which may explain the clinical miss. The failure of tau PET to move despite amyloid clearance is a key mechanistic signal — the amyloid-tau cascade may not be reversible at this stage, or the timeframe was insufficient.

ARIA-E occurred in 20.87% of gantenerumab vs 1.04% placebo — a substantial safety signal that may have led to dose modifications or discontinuations, potentially limiting exposure. The trial was terminated following pre-planned analysis showing lack of efficacy — this is a scientific/efficacy-based termination, not a commercial one. A secondary consideration is that tau pathology (PET) did not respond, suggesting the amyloid-tau-neurodegeneration cascade may not be fully reversible in this population/timeframe, contributing to the clinical miss.
